observations: Photo 0 shows a white, compact console with a perforated front panel and the Xbox logo. The console is placed on a wooden surface next to its box, which has 'Series S' visible on the side.
Photo 1 shows the same console from a different angle, highlighting the circular black vent on the front and the side ports. A black Xbox controller is next to it, along with some papers.
The console matches the known design of the Xbox Series S, including the white color, compact form factor, and front vent pattern.
The box in photo 0 clearly shows 'Series S' text, confirming the model.
The controller appears to be a standard Xbox wireless controller, black with colored face buttons.
